plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Drop JSON rule packs in the plugins folder. Validation rules extend the built-in HL7 checks, FHIR rules the FHIR checks, and anonymization rules the PHI catalogue. No code execution - plugins are pure data.
plugins.noPlugins: No plugins installed. Use the "Open plugins folder" button and create a .json file under validation/, fhir/ or anonymization/.
plugins.gated: Inactive — the Community tier allows up to 3 active plugins.
plugins.capReached: The Community edition runs up to {max} plugin packs at a time. Switch another pack off first, or upgrade to Professional for no limit.

samples.search: Search by type, name or description
samples.fictional: All patients and data are fictional.

fhirRules.title: FHIR validation rules
fhirRules.intro: Rules run alongside the built-in FHIR checks every time you validate a resource. Each rule is either a FHIRPath expression that must hold, or a path plus a check applied to the values it selects.
fhirRules.none: No rules yet — add one below.
fhirRules.pickOne: Select a rule to edit it.
fhirRules.expressionHint: Evaluated against the resource. The rule fires unless the result is exactly true.
fhirRules.pathHint: The check is applied to every value the selector returns. A selector that returns nothing satisfies every check except “must be present” and cardinality.
fhirRules.messagePlaceholder: Patient must have at least one identifier
fhirRules.testNeedsResource: Open a FHIR resource to test against.
fhirRules.passed: Rule passes on the open resource.
fhirRules.failed: Rule fires on the open resource:
fhirRules.notApplied: The rule did not apply: the open resource is not of that type.
fhirRules.preset.identifierMsg: Patient must have at least one identifier
fhirRules.preset.phoneMsg: Phone number has an unexpected format
fhirRules.preset.cardinalityMsg: Patient must have at least one name
fhirPackages.title: FHIR profile packages
fhirPackages.intro: The FHIR R4 core is built in, so every resource is checked against its base StructureDefinition: cardinality, element types, choice elements, fixed values, unknown elements. Install implementation guides on top to check the profiles a resource declares in meta.profile.
fhirPackages.whereToGet: Download an implementation guide as a .tgz from packages.fhir.org or your national FHIR registry, then install it here. The R4 core is already built in.
fhir.profilesApplied: Checked against the installed FHIR profile packages.

file.charsetUnsupported: {name} declares the character set {charset} (MSH-18), which BridgeLab cannot decode. It was opened as Windows-1252: names and other text may be wrong, and so may the field boundaries. Do not validate, anonymize or send it before converting it to UTF-8 with another tool.
file.charsetNotUtf8: {name} declares {charset} (MSH-18) but is not valid UTF-8. It was opened as Windows-1252; saving writes it as UTF-8, as it declares.
file.deletedOnDisk: "{name}" was deleted or moved by another program. The tab keeps its text; saving will ask before creating the file again.
file.changedReload: "{name}" was changed by another program. Load the new version?
file.changedReloadDiscard: "{name}" was changed by another program, and this tab has unsaved edits. Load the new version and discard your edits? (Cancel keeps your edits; saving will ask before overwriting.)
file.saveNewer: "{name}" was changed by another program since you opened or last saved it. Overwrite it with this tab?
file.saveRestored: "{name}" was restored with unsaved changes from the last session. Another program may have changed the file since then. Overwrite it with this tab?
file.saveDeleted: "{name}" was deleted or moved since you opened it. Create it again with this tab?
